characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Game Canon
characters.summary: Sandshrew is a ground-type Pokémon that burrows underground to escape danger and defense-rolls into a tight sphere to deflect physical blows. It uses sharp claws to scratch opponents and dig deep tunnels.

mechanisms: Curling into a hard ball to absorb physical impact

limitations: Vulnerable in environments lacking loose earth or sand for burrowing
Slow mobility when not rolling or burrowing

sources.supports: Abilities, types, moves, and evolution details of Sandshrew

feats.claim: Burrows deep underground in dry, desert-like areas to avoid moisture and find prey.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entry

feats.claim: Rolls into a ball to protect its hide from hard impacts and falls from heights.

unknowns: Exact speed while digging through various geological formations

characters.continuity: Pokémon Sun and Moon / Standard Game Canon
characters.summary: Alolan Sandshrew is an Ice/Steel-type variant of Sandshrew that inhabits snowy mountainous regions. It possesses a heavy steel shell covered in ice spikes and curls into an impenetrable ball when threatened.

mechanisms: Heavy steel-plated body covered in ice spikes

limitations: Heavier weight restricts traditional burrowing speed compared to the standard form
characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from Ground to Ice/Steel, alters appearance to a snow-adapted form with an ice shell, and modifies regional weaknesses and moves.

sources.supports: Alolan regional variant attributes, typing, and abilities

feats.claim: Slides across snow-covered terrain on its belly like a curling stone to move quickly.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses Ice-type biology and generates ice spikes

unknowns: Exact durability limits of the ice shell against extreme heat sources

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Game Canon
characters.summary: Slowbro is a Water/Psychic-type Pokémon created when a Shellder clamps onto a Slowpoke's tail. It is characteristically relaxed and absent-minded, but wields formidable psychic abilities and water attacks in combat.

mechanisms: Hard shell armor on the tail

limitations: Extremely slow-moving and oblivious to surroundings when not provoked
Vulnerable if the Shellder on its tail is detached

Capable of breathing underwater

Wields powerful innate psychic attacks like Psychic and Confusion
